violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW BEEF IN THE TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: RAW FOODS REORGANIZED DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED. PLEASE RE-EDUCATE EMPLOYEES.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED POTATO NOODLES AT 101 IN A WARMER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: POTATO NOODLES TAKEN TO STOVE TO REHEAT. THEY MUST BE KEPT ABOVE 58C OR 135F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED AT COUNTER COLD TABLE: COOKED CORN AT 50F (1HR), CUT CABBAGE AT 50F (1HR), AND COOKED EGG AT 46F (1HR) OBSERVED AT TWO-DOOR STANDING DISPLAY: KIMCHI AT 44F, COOKED BOBA AT 50F. ITEMS WERE PLACED IN COOLER THE NIGHT PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: IN COUNTER COLD TABLE, ICE WATER PUT AROUND FOOD TO COOL THEM DOWN PROPERLY. COOLER TURNED DOWN DURING INSPECTION. KIMCHI AND BOBA IN TWO-DOOR STANDING DISPLAY WERE DISPOSED OF. GANGNAM HOT DOG (Inspection Date: 06/11/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED POP, WATER, RICE, AND BULK DRY FOOD CONTAINERS STORED ON FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. YOU MUST PUT ALL FOOD INCLUDING DRINKS ON SHELVING. BY YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED TWO-DOOR STANDING DISPLAY COOLER BEHIND COUNTER AT 43F HOLDING FOOD 44-50F. OBSERVED FRONT COUNTER COLD TABLE AT 36.5F AND HOLDING FOOD 46-50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: BOTH COOLERS WERE TURNED DOWN DURING INSPECTION, AND ICE WATER WAS PUT AROUND FOOD CONTAINERS IN THE COLD TABLE.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE PERSONAL ITEMS AND CLOTHING STACKED ON FOOD CONTAINERS.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: EMPLOYEE ITEMS MOVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ADD DESIGNATED STORAGE LIKE WE SPOKE ABOUT. I RECOMMEND ADDING MORE SHELVING/VERTICAL STORAGE DUE TO THE LIMITED SPACE.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Open sprite container observed on 2 door prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC disposed of open soda container.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the @LOCATION@ is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Handwashing sink by the greasehoods and deep fat fryer is blocked by oil containers
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC moved containers of oil so handwashing sink can be accessed.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: EHS observed raw liquid eggs being stored on top of RTE cheese slices
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC moved cheese slices so they were no longer being stored under the raw liquid eggs.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped @Pest/Animals@ were found on the premises. Dead and trapped drain flies are observed in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. EHS asked PIC to change out fly traps on a frequent basis so dead and trapped flies can be removed from the facility.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers, originally containing Sprinkles were observed reused for the storage of MILK TEA, THAI TEA, and GREEN TEA
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS asked PIC to replace the single use containers with re-usable containers.
